params.message:
Fill empty slugs from the title on publish

On a hoet.be document, Publish now fills every empty slug from the title in
that language: lowercase, hyphens, no articles or punctuation, at most five
words, numbered when another document already carries it. A slug that is
filled in never changes by itself; changing one by hand forwards the old
address on the site (document_slugs, journal_slugs). The home page keeps no
slug, and other brands are left alone: their sites do not forward an old
address.

Validation now explains what is wrong and shows the fixed form: a domain or
whole address in front, " - " between keywords, spaces, capitals, other
characters, and more than five words. The word limit is an error on hoet.be
only; elsewhere shortening would break a live address, so it stays a warning.
An empty slug shows what it becomes on publish.

Portal: De slug van een nieuwe pagina, bril of story wordt bij publiceren vanzelf ingevuld uit de titel, in elke taal.
